name: PRONEXUS Inc.
summary: PRONEXUS Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides corporate disclosure and investor relation services in Japan. It offers PRONEXUS WORKS support system for disclosure documentation; WORKS-i and WORKS-Core optional systems; outsourcing services for disclosure document preparation; E-IR, an automatic updating service; translation services; IFRS disclosure support services; and seminars and training sessions. The company also provides smart convocation, event planning and administration, shareholder benefit, web newsletters support, website production and management, and video production services. In addition, it engages in system development, infrastructure building, content creation, and client support associated with preparation of disclosure documents. Further, the company offers databases, including those containing economic statistics, industry statistics, financial information, and corporate information; business process outsourcing services tailored to preparation of disclosure documents and support for consolidated financial reporting; video equipment and operational support services across an range of occasions, including corporate events, academic conferences, trade shows, and entertainment; and rental office and administrative outsourcing services. The company was formerly known as Asia Securities Printing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to PRONEXUS Inc. in October 2006. PRONEXUS Inc. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
